entry.title: My blog opening
entry.summary: Why I opened a new blog and what it covers.
entry.content: I closed my last blog seventeen years ago. This new one is for sharing what I know and my small experiments with embedded open source. It will mainly cover embedded Linux, plus open firmware, RTOSes and related topics such as virtualization and security.
